probe.title: maximilian kaspar – web and brand designer
probe.text_sample: maximilian kaspar – web and brand designer maximilian kaspar max kaspar photos about swiss based web and brand designer. currently working at stuiq. scroll down projects 3 linden branding, webdesign 2024 for the restaurant 3 linden i had the opportunity to created a new corporate identity. working on everything from the name, photography, branding and communication. combining the restaurant's long history with a modern and bold refurbishment. for that we created a bold logo that always seems to be in the way. a mysterious place that you need to experience in person. agency: client: website: photos: absolut agentur p1 gastronomie 3linden.ch zoomer agency li_001.jpg li_002.jpg li_003.jpg li_004.jpg li_005.jpg li_006.mp4 li_007.jpg li_008.jpg li_009.jpg li_010.jpg li_011.jpg cityparking webdesign, campaign 2024 Webdesign and brand refresh for the parking provider Cityparking St.Gallen. The project centered around the redesign of the website, which defined the visual system for both the updated logo, the campaign and all the print measures. The design is based on a strict grid, a black-and-white foundation with a neon pink accent color derived from the parking house architecture.
